Market today: Inflation fears are back, echoing the 70s, which is a big deal for growth names like yours. The driver is energy prices and wages, not just tech.

Your holdings: SOXL (-27.16%) and SPAL (-24.89%) are the clear SELL/TRIM signals needing attention. They are leveraged and decaying, and your margin amplifies drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on the broader market sentiment around inflation and energy prices. Also, watch how your chip names (SMH) behave.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged, losing positions and the overall inflation narrative.
plays: SOXL: TRIM. Leveraged decay is a killer, especially on margin. Consider reducing exposure.
SPAL: TRIM. Similar to SOXL, this leveraged ETF is a drag. Reduce risk.
CRWD: Consider adding to this position if it dips towards its 1H order block (265.83-268.20) as per scanner setup.
